notes.title: The Brand New Blob Life is LIVE!
notes.content:
Since Blob Life's release, I was on a mission to make it the best game for you.

There have been many game-changing transformations to the game: from the background, to the blobs' behavior. Let's take a look at these changes.

The Blobs

The blobs are cute, little aliens that require a LOT of attention. Here are some of the aspects that you should consider to maintain a happy life for the blobs.

Blobs develop affection

Throughout interactions with the player, including giving sweets, toys and petting them over time, the blobs develop affection!

Depending on their affection level, they act very differently. Sometimes, the blobs will show little hearts to prove their love more frequently. And some, don't even bother at all.

Blobs share their thoughts

Ever wondered what your blobs really need? Blobs have thought bubbles that show their current need. This includes the desire for food, sleeping and playing with toys.

If an available bed exists in the game world, a very fatigued blob will jump on it and sleep for the entire night.

Game Environment

Day/night cycle

Blob Life now has a full day and night cycle! Experience the lofty clouds at sunrise to the shining stars in the late evening.

During the times of the day, cozy and relaxing songs will begin to play.

Mountains and grass

The blobs have arrived to the green, cozy world of Earth. And with the visual overhaul, snowy mountains were added as the game's main background, along with thick grass layers.

New Items

Sweets, toys and building items are essential factors of a blob's every day life, which can significantly boost your relationship with them.
